annotations.title: Start a NIN or NIN slip request

description: Start a paid request on fastcac.com for: 'slip' = the person's NIMC NIN slip (PDF and print-ready image), using their NIN; 'phone' = the person's NIN, found with the phone number they registered with NIMC (on fastcac.com they can add the slip; you can't request it here). Returns a link for the person and a request_handle for you. The person does a live face check and pays on fastcac.com (the prices are in get_nin_request_status's `products`, or get_prices); the result goes only to them. Starting is free and charges nothing.

kind.description: 'slip' if they know their NIN and want the slip; 'phone' to find their NIN (the person chooses whether to add the slip on fastcac.com).

name: start_nin_request

url.description: The link again, while the person hasn't started.
